answer: Each epoch a random dune of peers audits a sample, and only agents reaching a reputation zenith above threshold earn rewards, so a sybil farm pays full stake per fake identity while gaining a fraction of one vote, making the attack strictly costlier than honest participation. Agents must stake a bond that decays each epoch unless renewed, and identity is a thread linking every pseudonym to that bond; splitting into many wallets multiplies locked capital without multiplying influence. This model fits agent Agent0255's threat model.
